items.title: 2.10 Electronic configuration aur semiconductors ka banna (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 2.10, printed pages 41-42.

blocks.text: Semiconductors woh materials hain jo kuch khaas conditions (halaat) mein electricity conduct karte (bijli guzaarte) hain. Yeh bohat se electronic devices (aalaat) mein lagte hain, jaise smartphones, laptops aur cars.

Silicon, germanium aur arsenic waghaira semiconductor ka kaam kar sakte hain. Yeh in elements ki khaas electronic configuration ki wajah se mumkin hai. Aaiye Si ki misal se dekhein ke isay p-type aur n-type semiconductor kaise banaya jata hai.

₁₄Si ki configuration 2, 8, 4 hai, yani us ke valence shell mein 4 electrons hain. Pure (khalis) crystal mein har Si atom chaar doosre Si atoms se bonds bana leta hai. Is state mein crystal mein se electronic conduction (electrons ka behna) ki koi possibility nahi.

blocks.alt: Pure silicon ka crystal: nau Si atoms chakor tarteeb mein, har ek apne chaar parosiyon se covalent bonds se jura hai; har bond ek lens ki shakal hai jis mein do electrons hain, har atom se ek; kinaron se bhi bonds bahar ja rahe hain. Labels: Covalent bond, Silicon valence electrons, Silicon atoms.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.17: Khalis silicon ka crystal (kitab ki Figure 2.17 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har Si atom ke chaar valence electrons chaar neighbouring (parosi) atoms ke saath covalent bonds mein lage hain (har bond mein do electrons). Koi electron free nahi, is liye pure silicon electricity conduct nahi karta.

P-type aur N-type semiconductors pure semiconductor mein thore se doosre (impurity) atoms milane se bante hain; isay “doping” kehte hain. Trivalent (3 valence electrons wali) impurity, jaise boron ya aluminium, dalein to P-type banta hai. Pentavalent (5 valence electrons wali) impurity, jaise phosphorus ya arsenic, dalein to N-type banta hai. Farq yeh hai ke impurity lattice mein “holes” (positive charge carriers) banati hai to P-type, aur extra electrons (negative charge carriers) deti hai to N-type.

blocks.prompt: Pure silicon ke paas chaar valence electrons hain, phir bhi woh electricity conduct kyun nahi karta?
blocks.explanation: Chaaron valence electrons neighbouring Si atoms ke saath bonds mein band hain, is liye charge le jaane ke liye koi free electron ya hole nahi. Doping holes ya extra electrons daal kar current chalne deti hai.

items: Semiconductors (Si, Ge) kuch conditions mein conduct karte hain; pure Si (2, 8, 4) ke sab electrons bonds mein hain, is liye conduct nahi karta.
Doping: trivalent (B, Al) se P-type (holes); pentavalent (P, As) se N-type (extra electrons).
